headline: Gold prices in Bangladesh jump by BDT 9,856 per bhori, reaching BDT 232,930
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) announced the significant increase, effective from 10 AM today. This marks the second price adjustment in less than a week.
details: Gold prices in the local market have seen a substantial increase, with 22-carat gold now costing BDT 232,930 per bhori, including VAT. This represents a hike of BDT 9,856 per bhori.
The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) announced this new pricing structure in a notification issued on Thursday, August 6. The revised rates became effective from 10 AM today.
BAJUS attributed the price adjustment to a rise in the value of acid gold (pure gold) in the local market. The decision was made after considering the overall market situation.
Under the new rates, 21-carat gold is priced at BDT 222,491 per bhori, 18-carat at BDT 191,056 per bhori, and traditional method gold at BDT 156,064 per bhori, all including VAT.
This is the second gold price adjustment by BAJUS recently. Previously, on July 31, the price of 22-carat gold was set at BDT 223,074 per bhori after an increase of BDT 2,216 per bhori.

headline_marked: [[Messi scores record double]] in first start since World Cup final, leads Inter Miami to victory
headline: Messi scores record double in first start since World Cup final, leads Inter Miami to victory
summary: Lionel Messi netted twice for Inter Miami in their 4-2 win over Atlético de San Luis, becoming the Leagues Cup all-time leading scorer with 14 goals. This was his first start since the 2026 World Cup final.
details: Lionel Messi became the all-time leading scorer in the Leagues Cup after netting twice in Inter Miami's 4-2 victory over Atlético de San Luis. This impressive performance occurred in the 2026 edition's opening group matches.
The Argentine superstar equalized the visitors' early goal in the 11th minute, converting a pass from Noah Allen. Telasco Segovia then put Miami ahead, setting the stage for more of Messi's magic.
Messi struck again just before half-time, once more converting an Allen assist. This second goal took his Leagues Cup tally to 14, establishing him as the competition's highest-ever scorer.

He also provided the corner kick that led to Micael scoring Miami's fourth goal before the break, showcasing his continued influence beyond just scoring. Messi had previously led Inter Miami to win the 2023 Leagues Cup shortly after joining the club.

This match marked the 39-year-old's second appearance for Miami and his first start since helping Argentina finish as runners-up at the 2026 World Cup in North America. Miami's next Leagues Cup fixture is against Monterrey on Saturday.

The Leagues Cup is an annual, official soccer tournament that includes all 18 clubs from Mexico's Liga MX and 18 qualified clubs from Major League Soccer (MLS) in the United States and Canada. This competition provides a unique platform for North American club football.
caption:
Lionel Messi has made history again! He scored a record-breaking double in his first start since the World Cup final, becoming the Leagues Cup's all-time leading scorer.

Lionel Messi became the all-time leading scorer in the Leagues Cup after netting twice in Inter Miami's 4-2 victory over Atlético de San Luis. This impressive performance occurred in the 2026 edition's opening group matches.

The Argentine superstar equalized the visitors' early goal in the 11th minute, converting a pass from Noah Allen. Telasco Segovia then put Miami ahead, setting the stage for more of Messi's magic.

Messi struck again just before half-time, once more converting an Allen assist. This second goal took his Leagues Cup tally to 14, establishing him as the competition's highest-ever scorer.

He also provided the corner kick that led to Micael scoring Miami's fourth goal before the break, showcasing his continued influence beyond just scoring. Messi had previously led Inter Miami to win the 2023 Leagues Cup shortly after joining the club.

This match marked the 39-year-old's second appearance for Miami and his first start since helping Argentina finish as runners-up at the 2026 World Cup in North America. Miami's next Leagues Cup fixture is against Monterrey on Saturday.

The Leagues Cup is an annual, official soccer tournament that includes all 18 clubs from Mexico's Liga MX and 18 qualified clubs from Major League Soccer (MLS) in the United States and Canada. This competition provides a unique platform for North American club football.
